lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling the salon. I'm the digital assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm unhappy about the treatment I had last Tuesday. I want to speak to someone in charge.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I'm sorry you've had a poor experience. I can request a callback from the salon manager. Can I take your name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bethan Hughes. My number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks, Bethan. I only caught nine digits. Could you repeat the full number, please?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sorry. Zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one two four.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: That's zero seven seven zero zero; nine zero zero; one two four. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes. I just want a proper explanation of what happened.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I've noted that you'd like an explanation. I'll pass your callback request to the salon manager. I can't confirm when they'll be available.
